## FAQs

### ACPC

[ACPC](https://gujacpc.admissions.nic.in/document-category/instructions-guidelines/)

### FAQs GCAS

#### FAQs GCAS

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Q.1 | Who has to register to GCAS portal? |
| Ans | GCAS portal serves as a platform for applying to have an admission in any of the state’s 15 government universities and their affiliated college’s programs. However, only students who apply for admission to university-college- programs through the GCAS portal will be considered for admission to the programs listed on the GCAS portal of the state's 15 government universities. |
| Q.2 | Does a student get admitted to the university or college through GCAS portal? |
| Ans | A student can register on the GCAS portal and secure admission in the college program of their choice in accordance with the prevailing rules of the respective university/college. |
| Q.3 | In how many languages is data/ information available on the GCAS portal? |
| Ans | GCAS Portal is a bi-lingual portal. The information is available in both English and Gujarati languages. |
| Q.4 | Can a student apply for multiple courses/Program/University/College through one application? |
| Ans | A student can choose more than one program- college-university in a single application. But student can get admission to single program through one application. |
| Q.5 | Will there be a common timeline for the procedures of registration to admission to different UG, PG and Ph.D. programs? What could be the procedure of the complete registration process for a student? |
| Ans | There will be separate schedule for the procedure from registration to admission for Graduation programs, Post-Graduation programs and Ph.D. The students have to fill their registration forms with academic details, choice of colleges they want to take an admission in, registration fees payment and final submission of the application as per the schedule applicable to the courses they are applying for. After the final submission of registration form, the students have to check provisional admission offer list, register their grievance, if any, and get them resolved, check final admission offer list, check admission offered by login in GCAS portal and confirm their admission after paying the fees along with the document verification at the college they want to seek an admission in. |
| Q.6 | How many colleges a student can choose for any course on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | Presently, there is no limit on the choice of the number of colleges for any course on the GCAS portal. |
| Q.7 | Can I change my email ID and/or mobile number used for registration on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | Students are recommended to be careful while filling in the Registration form. Email id and Mobile Number once used for registration must be retained with the students until the completion of the admission process as they are used for a correspondence related to admissions and hence after. It is a mandatory field, so fill it very carefully as they cannot be changed. |
| Q.8 | What are the additional documents required for students who have passed Std. 12 from boards other than GSHEB? |
| Ans | A list of documents which a student needs to upload on GCAS portal while applying for a particular degree course (as applicable) is available on GCAS portal. The link is: <https://gcas.gujgov.edu.in/Content/information-manual-for-ug-pg-phd-197> |
| Q.9 | Can I change the preferred list of colleges selected by me after the submission of the application on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | Yes. The student can update the details of his application by the last date of application if he wants even after the final submission of his application. But after every such update/edit/correction, it is mandatory to submit the application. |
| Q.10 | Can I change the major subject of the course after submitting the application on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | The student can update the main/major subject of his/her course by the last date of application even after the final submission of the application. But after every such update/edit/correction, it is mandatory to submit the application. |
| Q.11 | What if the result of my board is not declared before the last date of application on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | If any board has not declared its results during the first round of admission process on GCAS portal, the student may apply during the second round of admission process on GCAS portal which shall be conducting after the declaration of the results of Supplementary/Compartment Examination (પૂરક પરીક્ષા) of GHSEB subject to availability of the seats. |
| Q.12 | What if the server/site hangs during the application process on the last day, and I could not submit the final application? |
| Ans | All possible measures are taken during the development phase to avoid such a situation. However, such a problem may arise due to Internet issues or if a large number of students access the website simultaneously. The registration form has a “Save & Next” feature, which you may use if you are not able to complete the entire form in one session. You are recommended to click on the “Save” button on each page/session separately to save the information, and you may proceed with filling out the remaining online registration form after refreshing the link or logging into your account in another session. You are also recommended not to wait till the last day to complete or submit the online form. |
| Q.13 | Is there any concession on registration fees for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD applicants? |
| Ans | Registration fees apply to all students without concession. However, reserved category students may get concession in admission fees as per the rules and regulations of respective colleges/universities as per the Government of Gujarat norms. |
| Q.14 | How do I start the registration process? |
| Ans | You begin by filling out the registration form with your academic details and selecting the colleges where you wish to apply for admission. |
| Q.15 | What information do I need to provide in the registration form? |
| Ans | You'll need to fill in your academic details and specify your choices of Program-University-College for admission. |
| Q.16 | How do I pay the registration fees? |
| Ans | Payment of registration fees can be made through the specified method outlined in the registration guidelines.  You can pay the fee online by clicking on the 'Payment' button displayed on the dashboard with your log-in ID on the GCAS portal. |
| Q.17 | What happens after I submit my registration form? |
| Ans | After submission, you'll need to check the provisional admission offer list when published and you may register your grievances, if any, to the respective College-University. |
| Q.18 | How can I resolve any grievances I have with the admission process? |
| Ans | You can visit the Grievance Cell of concerned University/College and seek redressal of your grievances. |
| Q.19 | How do I know if I've been offered final admission? |
| Ans | To check which college you have been admitted to, click on the 'Offer' button displayed on the dashboard after logging into your GCAS portal account. |
| Q.20 | What's the next step after receiving a final admission offer? |
| Ans | After receiving the final admission offer, click on the 'Offer' button displayed on the dashboard after logging into your GCAS portal account. Download the offer letter for the program-college-university of your choice, where you intend to enroll and visit the University/College in person." |
| Q.21 | What documents do I need to provide for admission confirmation? |
| Ans | At the time of admission, ensure that you bring all original certificates uploaded on the GCAS portal. Additionally, it is recommended to carry one set of self-attested photocopies of these certificates. |
| Q.22 | When should I confirm my admission after receiving a final offer? |
| Ans | Upon receiving the final offer from your chosen college, it is important to promptly contact the college within the specified time frame as per schedule to secure your admission. |
| Q.23 | What if I have additional questions about the admission process? |
| Ans | If you have any further inquiries, you can refer to the provided guidelines or reach out to the respective University/College for assistance. |
| Q.24 | How do I register for the admission process? |
| Ans | You can register by filling in your basic details such as Course Type, Applicant’s Name, Birth Date, Category, Gender, Email, and Mobile Number on the registration portal. Make sure to complete your Basic Profile as well. |
| Q.25 | When can I fill in my academic details and choose colleges? |
| Ans | Once the results of the qualifying examination (Std. 12 or final year/semester of your College/University) are announced and you get the hardcopy of your mark sheet, you can fill in your academic details, select colleges, upload required documents, and pay the registration fees within the specified timeline. |
| Q.26 | What if my qualification mark sheets are in terms of Grades/CGPA? |
| Ans | You must obtain Conversion Certificates in the form of marks and percentages from your respective Board/University and upload them as it is mandatory. |
| Q.27 | How many colleges should I choose, and is it necessary to select all colleges within a university? |
| Ans | In universities other than Gujarat University, it is mandatory to select at least one college per program. However, Gujarat University requires selecting at least 3 colleges for B.A. (English Medium), 3 for Integrated Law, and 25 for B.Com. Program, and at least 5 colleges for all other programs. |
| Q.28 | Is there a deadline for submitting the application? |
| Ans | Yes. It is mandatory to submit the online application by the deadline specified in the guidelines for the respective programs available on the GCAS portal. It's important to note that students can edit their application until the final application deadline. |
| Q.29 | What happens if a student doesn't submit their corrected application? |
| Ans | Applications that are not submitted after corrections until the final application deadline will not be considered for admission. |
| Q.30 | When will the provisional admission offer list be declared? |
| Ans | The publication date of the provisional admission list is indicated in the guidelines for respective programs available on the GCAS portal. Additionally, students are advised to regularly check the website of the respective University/College for updates. |
| Q.31 | How can students view the provisional admission offer list? |
| Ans | Students can view the list for all universities/colleges/programs they selected in the admission form by logging into the GCAS portal. |
| Q.32 | What can students do if they have any grievances regarding the provisional admission offer list? |
| Ans | Students can register their grievances by visiting the Grievance Cell of respective University/College as per the schedule provided. |
| Q.33 | When will the final admission offer list be declared? |
| Ans | The announcement of final admission offer list will be made according to the date specified in the program guidelines available on the GCAS portal. Additionally, students are advised to regularly check the website of the respective University/College for any updates. |
| Q.34 | How can students confirm their admission offers? |
| Ans | To obtain their offer letter and confirm admission, students should log in to their account on the GCAS portal and click on the 'Offers' button on the dashboard. They can then print out the offer letter for the college where they have been admitted, proceed to the respective college, and confirm their admission. To complete the process, students need to provide the OTP received on his/her registered mobile number or email address to the college authorities and confirm admission. |
| Q.35 | Who is eligible for consideration in the second round of admissions? |
| Ans | Only students who have registered on the GCAS portal and submitted their application, but have not been admitted to any college in the first round, will be eligible for the second round. Students who have not confirmed admission to their chosen college in the first round will not be eligible for admission to that college in the subsequent rounds. |
| Q.36 | What does it mean to not be admitted to any college in the first round? |
| Ans | It means the student has neither confirmed admission nor been allotted admission to any college in the first round. |
| Q.37 | What is the Updated Admission Offer List? |
| Ans | The University/College will announce this list for vacant seats after the completion of the first round of admissions. |
| Q.38 | How can students confirm their admission offers in the second round? |
| Ans | After the updated admission list is released, the final admission offers will be displayed on the student's dashboard on the GCAS portal. A student can then print out the offer letter for the college in which they are admitted among their choices, proceed to the respective college, and confirm the admission. To complete the process, students need to provide the OTP received on his/her registered mobile number or email address to the college authorities and confirm admission. |
| Q.39 | Who is eligible for consideration in the third round of admissions? |
| Ans | Only students who have registered and submitted their application on the GCAS portal but have not been admitted to any college in both the first and second rounds will be eligible for the third round. |
| Q.40 | What does it mean to not be admitted to any college in the first and second rounds? |
| Ans | It means the student has neither confirmed admission nor been allotted admission to any college in both the first and second rounds. |
| Q.41 | Can non-admitted students get admission and update their choice of university-college-program after the second round? |
| Ans | Students who have not been admitted after the completion of second round, can update their university-college-program choice on the GCAS portal at the beginning of the third round as per the schedule provided in the guidelines. |
| Q.42 | Who can update their choices on the GCAS portal? |
| Ans | Only students who have not confirmed admission or not been admitted in the first and second rounds are allowed to update their choices. |
| Q.43 | While paying registration fees online, the amount is deducted from my bank account, but it is not showing on the GCAS Portal. What should I do? |
| Ans | In cases of fee payment issues, the student should contact the bank through which the fee was paid. For any technical problems, they should contact the technical helpline provided on the portal. |
| Q.44 | How can I retrieve my forgotten password for the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | Students can reset their password if it has been forgotten. The process of resetting the password is available in this link: <https://gcas.gujgov.edu.in/Content/general-instructions-196> |
| Q.45 | What should I do if I meet technical issues while filling out the application on the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | For technical queries, students may contact GCAS Technical Help Line on +91-79- 23277360 or they may also send an email on: support-gcas@gujgov.edu.in. Students may also check the Help Tab on the website of GCAS portal for further details. The link is: <https://gcas.gujgov.edu.in/Content/gcas-help-line-numbers-200> |
| Q.46 | Only Major subject is available on the GCAS Portal. What should I do to get details of Minoror Multidisciplinary subjects? |
| Ans | GCAS portal serves as a platform solely for the registration of admission applications. For information regarding minor and multidisciplinary subjects, academic qualifications, reservation rules, merit criteria, etc., students can refer to the respective university-college website or contact them directly. |
| Q.47 | Is there any helpline number available to assist the queries related to the GCAS Portal? |
| Ans | Yes. You can contact the helpline number of GCAS portal - 079-22880080. |
| Q.48 | During the admission process will I get the details of empty seats of the colleges I’ve selected? |
| Ans | GCAS portal is for registration of admission applications only. A student may get details of empty seats through the respective Colleges/Universities. |
| Q.49 | In the GCAS portal, I have created my account and filled in my registration form. Can I use the same account to fill in the registration form for my friend? |
| Ans | No, only a single candidate can apply from one account for GCAS Portal. |
| Q.50 | I do not have an email account. Can I use the email of someone else to create registration? |
| Ans | No, you should not use the email id of anyone else. It is advisable to register through your own personal email id. You must create a valid email account and remember its password, as all the communication from the GCAS will be sent to your registered email. |
| Q.51 | Will the students be eligible for registration to GCAS if they have passed their qualifying exams before the academic year 2023-24? Will there be any disadvantage to such students with gap? |
| Ans | Yes, any student who have passed the qualifying exam can register for the course of interest at GCAS. GCAS portal is for registration of admission applications only. For admission and/or eligibility related queries, a student/candidate may contact the respective Colleges/ Universities. |
| Q.52 | What is Domicile Certificate? |
| Ans | Domicile Certificate is an official document to prove that a person is a resident of State/UT. |
| Q.53 | What is Migration Certificate? |
| Ans | Migration Certificate is a document which helps in getting admission to another institution or any education board and it is issued at the completion of the course along with other necessary documents. It is issued by the concerned university or Board in which one studies. |
| Q.54 | What is Conversion Certificate? |
| Ans | Conversion Certificate is issued where grades/CGPA is to be converted into marks/percentages.It is issued by the board/university one studies in. |
| Q.55 | What is Provisional Eligibility Certificate? |
| Ans | Provisional Eligibility Certificate is a temporary certificate provided by the university one seeks an admission in. Students will get the Certificate from the university after a particular time period of the application for Provisional Eligibility Certificate (PEC). It has to be submitted in case of change of university in admission procedure. i.e., if one has done graduation from one university and he/she wants to do post-graduation from another university the PEC should be submitted. |
| Q.56 | I do not have ABC ID. What should I do? |
| Ans | ABC ID is not mandatory field on GCAS portal. One can also apply through GCAS portal even if he/she doesn’t have ABC ID. |

### FAQ 2024

#### FAQ 2024

| Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) |
| --- |
| Q. How can I make pdf of all documents? | A.  * If you have computer/laptop then with the help of scanner you can directly save the documents in pdf. * While if you have smart phone/tablet then you have to download app for scan and using this app you can scan the documents and save directly in to pdf. |
| Q. How can I know about the file size? | A. You can check the details /Properties of file to know the file size. |
| Q. Can I upload a file, whose size is not within the specified limit? | A. No, you have to upload all documents only within the specified limit given for that particular document. |
| Q. How can I reduce the file size? | A.  * If you have computer/laptop then you can use online option to compress/ reduce file size. * If you have smart phone/tablet then you can download app to compress/ reduce and using this app you can reduce the file size. * You may watch <https://youtu.be/yjrfpnez2sl> for more information. |
| Q. What I have to check after uploading the document and before putting tick on the check box for that uploaded document? | A. You have to zoom the uploaded document and check that the uploaded document is readable and appropriate. |
| Q. What are the fees to be paid for registration at the cyber space centres? | A. The designated cyber space centres (e-centres) are for facilitation purpose at free of cost. There is no separate fee to be paid at e- centre for registration. |
| Q. Can I do online registration from home? | A. Yes. You can do registration from anywhere, Where the internet facility available. |
| Q. I am unable to register online, can I do it offline? | A. No. You have to register online within time limit specified by ACPDC. |
| Q. How can I edit registration details before and after confirming? | A. Before confirmation of registration, you can edit registration details online. After confirmation of registration, for any EDIT you have to contact on number: 079-26566000. |
| Q. If the income certificate is in the name of mother, will it be valid? | A. In cases of divorce of parents or demise of father, income certificate in name of mother is valid and student needs to submit photocopy of divorce or death certificate of father. |
| Q. From where can I get certificate of Caste, Income, physically handicapped and In/ ex-Service men? | A. The following authorities are designated by the State Government for issuing the certificates:  **Caste Certificate (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS):** District Collector, Deputy Collector, Assistant Collector, Social Welfare Officer/District Development Officer/Dy. District Development Officer/Taluka Development Officer, Mamlatdar. (officers must be from Government of Gujarat)  **Income certificate:** District Collector, Deputy Collector, Assistant Collector, Prant Officer, Mamlatdar/District Development Officer/Taluka Development Officer, Talati Mantri (officers must be from Government of Gujarat)  **Physically handicapped certificate:** Government Medical officer countersign by civil surgeon.  **In-Servicemen:** Commanding officer of unit where serving.  **Ex- Servicemen:** Director, Sainik Welfare Board, Gujarat State or the District Sainik Welfare Officer.  **Non-Creamy Layer Certificate:** District Collector, Deputy Collector, Assistant Collector, Prant Officer, Mamlatdar/District Development Officer/Taluka Development Officer (officers must be from Government of Gujarat) |
| Q. What should I do if the name in School LC and other required certificate is not matching? | A. You should get that required certificate corrected from the issuing authority immediately. |
| Q. If I have studied from outside Gujarat, what is the procedure for admission through ACPDC? | A. If you are Originally a resident of Gujarat/If your parent have In/Ex-servicemen certificate/If your parent have certificate of services, then you have to submit the relevant certificate of your parents. (For sample formats refer: <https://acpdc.gujarat.gov.in/sample.html>)  If you are not Originally a resident of Gujarat and you do not have any above-mentioned certificate, in that case, you are eligible for admission in 5% seats of Government and Grant-in-Aid institutions. |
| Q. Which services are considered for Category of Services? | A. Following service are considered for Category of Services:  1. Officers or Employees of Central Government; or 2. Officers or Employees of Public Sector Undertakings of Central Government or any State Government; or 3. Officers or Employees of nationalized banks; or 4. Officers or Employees of United Nations, UNICEF, World Health Organization (WHO) and such other International Institutions located in Gujarat State; or 5. Gujarat Cadre Officers of Indian Administrative Service, Indian Police Service or Indian Forest Service working in Gujarat or working in other States on deputation; or 6. Officers or Employees of Gujarat Government posted outside Gujarat State for administrative reasons. 7. Officers or employees serving in defence services. |
| Q. What is the level of disability for availing seats under PH (Physically Handicapped) quota? | A. Not less than 40% |
| Q. If both parents are not alive then who can act as guardian for caste and income certificate? | A. Legal guardian. If there is no legal guardian the candidate shall be considered as orphan and in such case no income certificate is required. But orphan certificate is required. |
| Q. Is student of any category can apply for TFWS? | A. Yes, subject to valid income certificate issued by competent authority. |
| Q. How can I check my merit rank? | A. After declaration of merit rank, Candidate can verify their rank by log in into their module at NIC website. The same will be reflected in registration details. |
| Q. Where can I get information about the various colleges and branches coming under ACPDC? | A. From E-information booklet available on website <https://acpdc.gujarat.gov.in/> and <https://gujdiploma.admissions.nic.in/>. |
| Q. How much choices one candidate can fill? | A. Candidate can fill all available choices to him. There are no maximum criteria of choices in choice filling module. |
| Q. Can a candidate change the filled choices? | A. Yes. But within a stipulated time decided by ACDPC. |
| Q. If filled choices are not locked, is it safe to logout? | A. There is no need to lock filled choice until you complete your choice filling. However, the choice filled so far should be saved before logout. |
| Q. How many times can choices be edited? | A. Unlimited. But within a stipulated time decided by ACDPC. |
| Q. If a candidate wants to go for reshuffling, does he need to report at admitted institute? | A. No. |
| Q. If a candidate wants to go for reshuffling, does he need to pay the fees at the admitted institute? | A. No. Candidates are supposed to pay fees only after completion of online admission process. |
| Q. If I get admission of choice in mock round, can I secure it? | A. No. Mock round is a practice round. |
| Q. If the seats in reserved quota are full, can the candidate from SC/ST/SEBC/PH/ESM/EWS get admission in Open category? | A. This Question does not arise, because, category candidates have been allotted first in open category seats, if that seat not available than only reserved category seats will be allotted. |
| Q. If a SC/ST/SEBC candidate gets admission under open category, will he be eligible for scholarship from government? | A. Yes, if the candidate meets other requirements for eligible for scholarship. |
| Q. Where is the information for fee structure of self-finance institutes available? | A. The information for fee structure of self-finance institutes is available on Fee Regulatory Committee website [www.frctech.ac.in](http://www.frctech.ac.in). Fee details provided in the Information Booklet too. |
| Q. After allotment, in how many days do we have to report at admitted institute? | A. It is advisable to report within 3 working days, If you don't want to participate in next round of Admission. Candidates are supposed to pay fees only after completion of online admission process. |
| Q. Is there any reservation or special quota for girls? | A. No. There are two government polytechnics for only girls students. One in Ahmedabad and other in Surat |
| Q. How and when do I get information for availability of vacant seats in various institutes? | A. you can get information after seat allotment of each round, on official website: <https://acpdc.gujarat.gov.in/> |
| Q. How can I check that, elsewhere i could have got admission? | A. From the cut-off marks details put up on official website after each round of allotment of seats. |
| Q. If I will get admission in management quota, can I still go for reshuffling in regular quota? | A. Yes. |
| Q. How to confirm allotted seat? | A. Candidate can verify their allotment status by log-in in his module. The result section will display allotment status.  * In case of zero fees, candidate can confirm his admission by accepting admission. * Rest of candidates can confirm their admission by paying token tuition fees. |
| Q. If I have passed with Basic Mathematics in Std 10. Am I eligible for admission in Diploma Engineering? | A. Yes, Candidate passed Std. 10 with Mathematics or Basic mathematics or Standard mathematics from eligible board is eligible for admission in Diploma Engineering. |
| Q. Who can get admission in Diploma Engineering? | A. Any candidate of eligible board of Std 10 having marksheet with “QUALIFIED FOR SECONDARY SCHOOL CERTIFICATE” with Standard/Basic mathematics, Science and English subject can get admission in Diploma Engineering. |
| Q. Is there any provision for Orphan / Widow to get SEBC category benefit in Diploma Engineering admission? | A. Yes. To get SEBC category benefit for admission in Diploma Engineering, the orphan of any caste has to upload the certificate regarding being orphan issued by the competent authority (Jan Seva Kendra) at the place of caste certificate as well as Non-Creamy Layer Certificate and Widow of any caste has to upload the certificate regarding being Widow issued by the competent authority (Jan Seva Kendra) at the place of caste certificate as well as Non-Creamy Layer Certificate during registration for admission in Diploma Engineering. |
| Q. If, I have passed 2 years ITI Certificate Course after passing Std.10 from eligible Board, can I get Lateral entry admission in any diploma course or in a corresponding diploma course according to the trade? | A. Yes, Candidate who has passed the eligible certificate course as available on official website of ACPDC can get admission in any diploma course as per Rule 6 of Existing Notification available on the official website of ACPDC. |
| Q. If I have not confirmed the admission allotted during the first round. Can I get admission in the same course and same Institute during the second round? | A. No. |
| Q. If I do not have my own bank account, Which account number can be filled during the registration process for diploma admission? | A. If candidate do not have his/her own bank account, he/she can fill the details of the bank account jointly held with parents. |
| Q. What If I do not fill the bank account details during the registration process for diploma admission? | A. If the candidate do not fill the bank details, in such cases if he/she is eligible for refund of the token tuition fees, then he/she has to accept the norms regarding the method of refund as decided by ACPDC. |
| Q. Can a candidate unlock the filled choices? | A. Yes. But within a stipulated time decided by ACDPC. |
| Q. After seat allotment, can I download provisional admission letter any time? | A. Yes, after seat allotment, candidate can download provisional admission letter during entire admission process through his/her login. |

NOTE: Above Frequently asked questions answers are for admission process and its easy understanding only. For latest update refer notification on <https://acpdc.gujarat.gov.in/>. This information should not be used for any legal aspect.
